sections.content:
Nothing changed! The magenta and purple are still in the same positions. The click at (45, 45) didn't move anything. This is strange.
Wait - maybe the click needs to be closer to the object to move it? Or maybe there's a minimum distance threshold?
Let me reconsider. Earlier, clicking at (32, 36) moved the magenta at (36, 40). The distance was about sqrt((36-32)^2 + (40-36)^2) = sqrt(16+16) = sqrt(32) ≈ 5.7.
And clicking at (40, 40) moved the magenta at (53, 48)... wait, no it didn't. The magenta at (53, 48) didn't move when I clicked at (40, 40). The distance was sqrt((53-40)^2 + (48-40)^2) = sqrt(169+64) = sqrt(233) ≈ 15.3. That's much farther.
But the purple at (39, 39) was at distance sqrt((40-39)^2 + (40-39)^2) = sqrt(2) ≈ 1.4 from the click at (40, 40). So the purple moved because it was closest.
Then clicking at (35, 42) moved the purple from (39, 39) to (34, 41). Distance was sqrt((39-35)^2 + (41-42)^2) = sqrt(16+1) = sqrt(17) ≈ 4.1.
And clicking at (45, 45) - the purple at (34, 41) was at distance sqrt((45-34)^2 + (45-41)^2) = sqrt(121+16) = sqrt(137) ≈ 11.7, and the magenta at (53, 48) was at distance sqrt((53-45)^2 + (48-45)^2) = sqrt(64+9) = sqrt(73) ≈ 8.5. So the magenta was closer, but it didn't move.
Maybe there's a maximum distance for the click to work? Or maybe I need to click directly on the object or very close to it?
Let me try clicking directly on the magenta at (53, 48).
